status: pilot policy; to be confirmed by the researcher and written into validation/model_spec.json at the pre-confirmation freeze
original_rule: equal unpadded tokens within every pair (training) and across context doses (evaluation); no padding or truncation
adopted_for_pilot_rounds: no padding and no truncation, as before
pairs are not required to be token-equal; every run records attention and loss tokens per block and per arm
report the arm-level token difference with every contrast (matrix_m1: intervention arms +0.4% IT, +0.1% CT against clean)
a pair whose texts differ by more than 15% in tokens is flagged for review, not excluded
why: exact equality would require rewriting 6,729 pairs with the tokenizer in the loop and re-judging them; the measured differences are a few tokens in about 117
open: whether confirmation requires exact equality, a tolerance, or reporting only
